articleTitle: Design of SRAM Based Interface Module with DMA in Inductive-Coupling 3D Stacked IoT Chips
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: To support the growing demands to integration, various integration methods have been widely exploited. Among various design options, inductive coupling based integration is featured with both flexibility and low cost. However, most prior works on inductive coupling based integration focus on circuit level details without addressing the overhead to the processors. In this paper, a novel SRAM based interface module is proposed for inductive-coupling 3D stacked IoT chips. By using the direct memory access (DMA) technology, the module provides off-chip memory access without CPU intervention and automatic control of the inductive link. In addition, a burst transmission scheme is introduced to improve the channel utilization with a handshaking protocol to ensure data integrity. Experimental results validate the functionality of the proposed design and demonstrate both flexibility and efficiency.

articleTitle: Zero-Sequence Fault Diagnosis and Wave Recording System Based on Transient Components Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: When the single-phase ground occurs in the power system with neutral point non-effectively grounding, the real-time awareness of magnitude and direction of the zero-sequence current is a difficult problem in engineering practice. In this paper, a zero-sequence fault diagnosis and wave recording system based on the transient components analysis is proposed. The proposed system can record the zero-sequence fault process completely, including the steady state before the fault, the transient state during the fault and both of the transient and steady state after the fault. In addition, the proposed system can analyze the fault data and process the transient components in pre-fault, mid-fault and post-fault. Through application analysis for waveform under various fault conditions and comparisons of line selection accuracy, the effectiveness of the method is verified. And the application result indicates that the proposed system can identify various type of faults effectively and improve the accuracy of faulty line selection.

Author Keywords: Zero-sequence fault diagnosis and recording system

articleTitle: A Load Classification Method Based on SA-LSTM Network Considering Category Imbalance Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: In order to master the regularity of user power consumption and enhance the service quality for electricity users, the refined classification of user load is of great significance for power company. Therefore, in load classification research, a load classification method based on Self Attention Long Short Term Memory (SA-LSTM) neural network considering category imbalance processing is proposed to address the imbalance of load categories and the performance defects of the classification model. First, for addressing the issue of load category imbalance, the generation adversarial network (GAN) based on Wasserstein distance is constructed to oversample the minority category samples; second, for enhancing the classification accuracy, the LSTM load classification model improved by Self Attention mechanism is built to identify the load type of user; third, the typical power consumption pattern is obtained by calculating the centroid of the classification results. The effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method are evaluated in an experiment by the classification of actual load data measured in a certain place.

articleTitle: A Low-Hit-Zone Frequency-Hopping Communication System for Random Access of Power Internet-of-Things
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: The communications networks are the basic component for the information collections and transmission in power internet-of-things (IoTs). To meet the development requirements of multiple power service in the future, wireless communications technique which has the merits such as flexibility and extensibility, is one of the potential solutions for power IoTs. The power IoT has the characteristics of large-scale power node access (large-scale connectivity), random access and high security and reliability. A frequency-hopping (FH) technique with low-hit-rate FH pattern in random access is proposed for power IoTs. The construction algorithm of such FH pattern is proposed by the combination and shift operation on a conventional FH sequence. By the numerical and simulations, the properties of the proposed FH pattern and the error-rate of FH-based power IoTs are evaluated. The analysis reveals that the FH networks employing the proposed FH pattern can well meet the requirements of the power IoTs (e.g., massive connectivity and high reliability), which will be widely implemented in the future applications.

articleTitle: An Improved Power Line Communication System Based on FH-OFDM Transmission Scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: Power line carrier (PLC) has been widely applied in the various scenarios in future energy-of-networks, e.g., remote data acquisition in power grid, smart home and intelligent device control. However, due to the nature of power line, the PLC suffers from the specific noise/interference and the server frequency selective fading, which seriously degrade the transmission performance and spectral efficiency. To address the aforementioned issues, a frequency-hopping (FH) based multicarrier orthogonal frequency division multiplex communication is proposed for PLC systems (FH-OFDMPLC) in this paper, where the centric frequency of OFDM signal is hopped randomly according to the pre-designed hopping strategy so that avoiding the interference and fading channels. The signal processing in transceiver of FH-OFDM PLC is analyzed in details. Compared to the existing PLC system, e.g., the traditional OFDM PLC, the simulation results are shown that, the proposed FH-OFDM PLC can efficiently combat the effect of the fading channel and noise on performance, and it leads to the significant improvement of SNR gains and bit-error rate (BER) performance. The proposed FHOFDM PLC system can provide the reliable transmission links for multi-services integration in future energy-of-networks.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Energy Sharing in Parks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: Under the guidance of the national policy, various kinds of distributed energy technology have developed rapidly. Distributed energy equipment has gradually become a nonnegligible participant in the park-level microgrid. However, different property rights also lead to insufficient utilization of the distributed energy equipment, which has become an important factor impeding the application of distributed energy technology. In this paper, a distributed energy sharing model is proposed. Firstly, the framework, participants and process of the model are illustrated. And then, the cost allocation method between energy trusteeship users and the benefit allocation method between energy sharing users under the model are established. Finally, a case study is put forward, which verifies the feasibility and correctness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Energy Pricing and Management for Integrated Community Energy System with CCHP and PV Devices: A Game Theoretic Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: As a new entity, the community operator (CO) who can supply electricity, heat and cold to users in the integrated community energy system (ICES) will play an important role in the future energy market. How to develop the best energy pricing strategy and achieve a win-win situation between CO and users is essential for the economic operation of the ICES. Given this background, an ICES with CCHP, PV, electric boiler (EB) and electric chiller (EC) is addressed. First, an interactive framework of the ICES is proposed, including the energy suppliers, CO and users. A Stackelberg game model is then established, in which CO (the leader) and users (the follower) rationally seek optimal strategies to maximize their own benefits and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed to obtain the equilibrium solution. Finally, a case of ICES is employed to demonstrate the present model and the solution method. The simulation results show that the model can give full play to the potential of the shiftable load and the multi-energy coupling devices, as well as coordinating the benefits between CO and users.

articleTitle: Two-stage Optimal Allocation Method of Distribution Network Based on Transformer Selection in Distribution Area
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: With the gradual advancement of the rural revitalization strategy, the level of rural electrification has been continuously improved, and the electricity demand have been significantly increased. At the same time, higher requirements have been put forward for township distribution network planning. In this paper, the transformer selection is taken as the core, the whole life cycle cost of transformer is taken as the objective function, and “n-1” principle, load rate and voltage fluctuation are taken as constraints. A two-stage optimization model of distribution network is established which takes into account initial investment planning and transformer optimal investment year. The model is solved by Yalmip+Cplex and traversal method. The effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method are verified through the analysis of numerical examples.

articleTitle: RS-SVGG: An Intelligent Circulating Tumor Cell Detection Method Based on VGG
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: The image-based C irculating T umor C ell detection is a powerful tool for both the diagnosis and the recovery process of cancer. However, healthy cells are dominant in the captured image in most scenarios. That makes the task of recognition CTCs from healthy cells can barely be manually achieved. This paper presents RS-SVGG, a machine learning based automatic CTC detection method based on VGG network. RS-SVGG adopts Multi-scale Region Selective Search algorithm to split the original large size image into small fixed-sized suspected target CTC images. Then final CTCs are detected from these target CTC images by SVGG, which is an optimized VGG network. The proposed method was evaluated using real clinical images. The experimental results show that RS-SVGG outperforms traditional image processing methods and can achieve up to the accuracy of 97.56%, which also outperforms the detection accuracy of human.

articleTitle: CAN FD Message Authentication Enhances Parallel in-vehicle Applications Security
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: Controller Area Network with Flexible Data-rate(CAN FD) has the advantages of high bandwidth and data field length to meet the higher communication requirements of parallel in-vehicle applications. If the CAN FD lacking the authentication security mechanism is used, it is easy to make it suffer from masquerade attack. Therefore, a two-stage method based on message authentication is proposed to enhance the security of it. In the first stage, an anti-exhaustive message exchange and comparison algorithm is proposed. After exchanging the message comparison sequence, the lower bound of the vehicle application and redundant message space is obtained. In the second stage, an enhanced round accumulation algorithm is proposed to enhance security, which adds Message Authentication Codes(MACs) to the redundant message space in a way of fewer accumulation rounds. Experimental examples show that the proposed two-stage approach enables both small-scale and large-scale parallel in-vehicle applications security to be enhanced. Among them, in the Adaptive Cruise Control Application(ACCA), when the laxity interval is 1300$\mu$s, the total increased MACs is as high as 388Bit, and the accumulation rounds is as low as 40 rounds.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Lithium-ion Batteries Based on Particle Filter with Generalized Exponential Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: A remaining useful life (RUL) prediction method is proposed, which uses a particle filter (PF) with the generalized exponential distribution (GE). There are three parameters in the adopted GE and the maximum likelihood estimation is used to estimate the parameters of GE. Due to the parameters in GE, more prior information in historical data can be absorbed and taken into PF for RUL prediction. The battery data from NASA Prognostics Center of Excellence Data Set Repository (PCoE) are used to compare the performance of the proposed method and that of using PF with the exponential function. The experiment results show that the performance of the proposed method is better.

articleTitle: DCCHP Cost Refinement Methodology Taking into Account New Energy Output and Load Forecast Errors
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: Distributed combined cooling, heating and power systems (DCCHP) are the main form of distributed energy systems. Currently, predicted values are used for source load data when calculating the DCCHP cost. However, the limitations of various load forecasting methods and renewable energy output forecasting methods can result in errors in the forecast data, which in turn affects the accuracy of the costing of the combined supply system. This paper establishes a comprehensive model of DCCHP with participating components, uses the Latin hypercube sampling technique to simulate fluctuations in the prediction errors of various types of load and renewable energy output forecasts, and uses the scenario reduction technique to extract typical scenarios that can cover most of the errors, and then performs cost calculations for each typical scenario to obtain the system cost with the prediction errors weighted by probability. Finally, simulations and sensitivity analysis are carried out for a typical DCCHP. The results show that the proposed method is able to calculate the actual cost of the DCCHP for different prediction values with different accuracy, providing an effective reference for practical system planning and design.

articleTitle: A Human Motion Capture System Based on MEMS Inertial Measurement
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: Motion capture system is usually used to measure the body posture and track the trajectory of motion in three-dimensional space. With the emergence of MEMS inertial sensors that is low power consumption and high integration, the motion capture system based on MEMS inertial measurement has been applied various market prospect. In this paper, we realized a human motion capture system based on inertial sensors, which is low-cost, real-time. The system is mainly composed of sensor measurement unit and pose estimation unit on PC. The sensor unit exchanges data with PC through general WiFi network. A sensor unit includes 9-axis inertial sensors (three-axis gyroscope, three-axis accelerometer and three-axis magnetometer), MCU and network communication module. The sensor units were attached in some parts of the human body to collect the 9-axis information of limbs in real time. The 9-axis information was transmitted to the pose estimation unit through the network communication module. The orientation of single sensor unit was estimated although madgwick algorithm. The pose estimation unit used human skeleton model and vector representation to reconstruct and track the whole-body posture. Finally, qualitative and quantitative tests were carried out. Experiments showed that the system had good dynamic characteristics and high precision.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity Joint Estimation for Asynchronous Massive Internet of Things: An ADMM Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: In this paper, low-complexity algorithms based alternating direction method of multiplier (ADMM) framework are proposed for joint channel estimation, activity detection and delay detection in asynchronous massive Internet of Things (IoT). In particular, an asynchronous frame structure with a maximum tolerable delay is used to model the sporadic transmissions in IoT. Ajoint estimation is formulated as a recovery problem for sparse signals. Taking advantage of the special sparse structure, we propose a linear ADMM algorithm for single-antenna estimation and a two-stage ADMM algorithm for multi-antenna estimation without any prior information, respectively. In addition, the computation complexity of the proposed algorithms is analyzed. Normalized mean square error, false alarm rate, and missed alarm rate are discussed to measure the accuracy of the proposed algorithms. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithms have superior performance in terms of recovery accuracy, activity detection, and computation efficiency. More importantly, the proposed algorithms have strong robustness to delay.

articleTitle: A survey of video human behaviour recognition Methodologies in the Perspective of Spatial-Temporal
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: Currently, video human behaviour recognition is the most foundational task of computer vision. The conventional recognition frameworks are building based on the images only, with current the wide usage of surveillance video as well as human behaviours are increasingly related to temporal information, video-based behaviour recognition has been widely studied by current researchers. This paper addresses multiple current research works and does the comparison between the variants of these algorithms. The methodologies are considered to be separated into traditional recognition and deep learning based methods which have reached the highest accuracy during current research works. Our paper does the comparison of existing frameworks and datasets which are related to video-type datasets only. We investigated multiple types of neural networks which are utilized for behaviour information extraction, as well as the challenges facing for our conventional and current methods. The deep learning based methodology for extracting both spatialtemporal information has involved plenty of frameworks. We compared the pros and cons of current existing works and provide the further research directions based on existing works

articleTitle: RepShardChain: A Reputation-Based Sharding Blockchain System in Smart City
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart cities with emerging technologies as the core, the attendant problems of data sharing and data security have attracted extensive attention. As an emerging distributed storage technology, blockchain has the characteristics of decentralization, transparency and credibility, tamper proof, and traceability, which is very suitable for data sharing and storage in smart cities. However, the scalability and consensus mechanisms of blockchain are not applicable to real-time data sharing requirements and resource-constrained Internet of things (IoT) devices in smart cities. According to the needs of smart cities, this paper designs a data sharing model RepShardChain based on reputation and sharding blockchain, designs a reputation-based proof-of-work (PoW) consensus mechanism to adapt to the IoT devices with limited resources, designs a reputation-based random sharding scheme to avoid malicious attacks, designs an incentive mechanism that takes into account the rewards and punishments of nodes, and incentivizes nodes to perform normal behavior to obtain more rewards, so as to realize the safety and efficiency of the blockchain. And we analyze the security of the proposed RepShardChain against various attacks. Simulation experiments show that the proposed model has higher throughput and higher security than the traditional blockchain.

articleTitle: A Distribution Network Flexible Resource Capacity Configuration Method with Large Renewable Energy Sources Access
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: Extensive research have been done to improve the rate of renewable energy consumption. However, how to select an appropriate scheme among these methods has become a key issue for distribution network investors. In this paper, a comprehensive evaluation index system is put forward and a flexible resources allocation model is established. Firstly, a RES output scenario reduction method based on machine learning is utilized to reduce the impact of the uncertainty output of renewable energy sources (RES). Further, a comprehensive evaluation index system for the distribution network is established to guide the configuration result of flexible resources. Moreover, a flexible resource configuration model considering both system flexibility and economy is established, and the second-order cone relaxation method is introduced to deal with the nonlinear terms. Finally, an IEEE-33 system is selected as a case study to verify the presented models. The result shows that the flexible resource capacity configuration model can effectively improve the DG consumption rate and alleviate the transmission pressure of distribution network lines. The economic benefits index characterizes the rationality and validity of the configuration model proposed in this paper, which provides decision-making assistance for the main investors of distribution network.

articleTitle: Memory Layout Optimization for Task-Based Intermittent Computing Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: The embedded system with energy harvest equipment collects the energy required for system operation from its working environment and releases it from the battery. However, the equipment can only provide intermittent power because environmental energy fluctuates. As a result, to assure the program’s progress, the program states must be stored timely and frequently. A promising paradigm for providing this capability is the task-based intermittent computing, in which each task is executed atomically and the states stored in shared memory across task boundaries must be preserved. The total number of saved states influences execution energy and time, and memory layout influences the saved memory interval of each task. In this paper, we model and analyze the influence of memory layout on the task-based computing system, and we establish an optimization problem for memory layout aimed at reducing the unnecessary operations on state backup. A heuristic algorithm based on genetic algorithms is proposed to obtain the approximate optimal solution in polynomial time. The benchmark test evaluation results show that, by optimizing the layout of memory variables, the proposed method significantly reduces the cost of state saving and improves execution efficiency.

articleTitle: Behavior-Tree Based Scenario Specification and Test Case Generation for Autonomous Driving Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: Autonomous driving systems are notoriously difficult to be made safe, largely attributed to their complex and dynamic environments, also known as scenarios. Simulation is an effective way to find uncovered safety bugs and compare autonomous driving algorithms through a large number of concrete scenarios (or test cases). The behavior tree is an established formalism for describing and controlling the behaviors of actors in game AI as well as robotics. In this paper, we propose a new approach based on the Behavior Tree for scenario specification and test case generation. We propose a scenario description language, called BTScenario, which supports both the high-level description of the spatial layout of map objects (e.g. roads and junctions) and the Behavior Tree-based specification of temporal behaviors of actors (e.g. cars and pedestrians). Furthermore, we implement the BTScenario program with the off-the-shelf opensource Behavior Tree library, PyTrees, to automatically generate test cases for simulation platforms. We test driving areas on maps to find bugs and compare different control algorithms by a large number of test cases generated automatically.

articleTitle: Optimal Energy Management of Remote-Rural-Microgrid Based on Ladder-type Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: In recent years, the high construction cost of distribution network extension projects faced by remote rural areas has brought severe challenges to the regional power load supply. Making full use of the abundant renewable resource endowment has become a new idea to balance supply and demand in the region. However, the intermittent uncertainty of wind and solar power brings technical challenges to economic operation. Therefore, based on ladder-type carbon trading mechanism, this paper proposes a two-stage robust energy management model to facilitate renewable energy consumption and improve the economics of dispatch operation. Before the uncertainty is realized, the day-ahead stage determines operating strategy that can withstand the worst-case uncertainty. As long as the uncertainty is observed, the operating units will be adjusted in the real-time stage to compensate for prediction errors. Based on duality theory, Big-M and Column Constraint Generation (CCG) algorithm, the above model can be solved, which ultimately provides the optimal economic day-ahead scheduling strategy. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Utility-oriented Offloading with Multiple Service Constraints for Mobile-Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: As one of the key technologies to facilitate the development of 5G/6G technologies, mobile edge computing (MEC) is a new computing model for mobile devices to provide services in close proximity. Due to the limited resources, designing a reasonable and efficient task offloading and resource allocation scheme for MEC systems is of importance to meet the high quality of experience (QoE) and to improve the service performance of the system. In this paper, due to the different quality requirements of each user, we design individualized utility metrics for each user based on the transmission capabilities of different devices. Then the constraints of computational resources and system time-average energy consumption are added to formulate a stochastic optimization problem, which jointly optimizes the offloading strategy, power resource allocation, and channel resource allocation to maximize the time-average utility. We decouple the original problem into deterministic subproblems on each time slot with Lyapunov optimization theory and propose an online optimization algorithm for utility quality (OAUQ). The simulation results show that the algorithm can maximize the utility while ensuring the long-term stability of the system.

articleTitle: In-Memory Multi-Bit Multiplication and Accumulation (MAC) Using FeFET for Energy Efficient IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: To meet the huge computing demands of data-intensive applications, resource constrained IoT devices have to address the data migration issue, i.e., memory wall, in the conventional Von Neumann architecture to achieve the desired energy efficiency. Recently, Computing-in-Memory (CiM) has been considered as a promising alternative to overcome memory wall and extensively investigated for its deployment in IoT devices using SRAM, DRAM and Non-Volatile Memory (NVM). Among various devices, FeFET (Ferroelectric FET) is an non-volatile device option featured with separate write/read paths and large on/off ratio, etc, thus is promising for building CiM designs. In this paper, we propose a multi-bit CiM design using 2-FeFET memory that can directly perform the key multiplication and accumulation (MAC) operation of neural networks as well as more complex convolution and matrix-vector multiplication. In addition, we investigate the impact of the device non-linearity on the MAC output, and propose to use a non-linear quantization and mapping between the discharge time and the FeFET polarization state to further improve the operation linearity. Experiment results show that the proposed design can achieve desirable accuracy, with almost $6\times$ fewer transistors than 6T SRAM array, when implementing the same computation, as well as $1.42\times$ improvement in energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy Park Flexibility Assessment Based on Users’ Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: With the large-scale access of distributed renewable energy to the power system, its volatility and uncertainty pose challenges to the flexibility and adjustment ability of the system, and the integrated energy system of the park as an effective organizational method of distributed power generation, its flexible support potential for the system needs to be tapped. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a flexible resource assessment model of the integrated energy system of the park based on the integrated demand response. Firstly, based on the equipment level, the distributed energy equipment in the park is physically modeled; secondly, the integrated demand response model of the user side of the park is established; then, the optimal scheduling strategy of the park is constructed to consider the integrated demand response; and finally, the flexible resource evaluation model of the park is established based on the optimization scheduling results of the park. The results show that the proposed model can effectively evaluate the flexibility resources of the park, provide support for the power system to cope with the fluctuation of distributed power generation, and improve the flexibility, reliability and economy of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Dispatching of a Park Integrated Energy System Considering the Integrated Demand Response of End Users
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: Under the background of energy internet, the traditional demand-side response of electric power will gradually develop to the direction of integrated demand-side response, so the modeling and classification of user types can accurately control the potential of demand response in the park. This paper first considers the types and characteristics of energy-using equipment of each end user in the park, dividing the end user in the park into industrial user, commercial user and resident user. Then the integrated demand response models of different types of users are established. On this basis, taking the maximum total revenue of the park operators as the optimization target, considering the coupling, conversion and storage constraints of power, heat, gas and other energy resources in the park, an optimized operation model of the park is established, which takes into account the integrated demand response of all types of end users. Finally, an example is employed to verify the validity of the proposed model, which shows that classifying the end users can more effectively guide and motivate the end users to participate in integrated demand response, and achieve the coordination and optimization of resources on both sides of the supply and demand in the park.

articleTitle: Reputation Driven Distributed Power Transaction Blockchain Model for Prosumers
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: Given the increasing penetration of distributed renewable energy, the distributed energy trading among prosumers can improve the uptake of renewable energy. But some market subjects are prone to default due to their selfishness, such behaviors will affect the economic benefits of other prosumers. In this paper, we investigate distributed energy trading blockchain model driven by the reputation. First, this paper introduces a reputation scoring model to describe how each prosumer performs the contract. Second, a transaction matching mechanism based on reputation ranking is adopted for increasing the priority of high reputation users. Finally, a price update strategy based on adaptive aggressive is employed to reach a contract quickly. The proposed model is tested on the IDE-Remix and Ganache platforms. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed distributed energy trading model.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation and Planning of New Power System Carrying Capacity
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: To adapt to the uncertainties under the future energy structure change, the power system transformation elements on the energy side, load side and grid side are analyzed and composed. And then, the concept of carrying capacity is proposed and conducted from three perspectives: the definition, the assessment indicators and how the indicators guide the planning. The proposed carrying capacity indicators are embedded into the grid planning model in the form of objective functions or constraints. In the final, the Garver-18 nodes test system is applied to verify the correctness and validity of the indicators and the planning model.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimal Scheduling of Commercial Park Microgrid Considering Flexible Resources on the Demand Side
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: The fluctuation a and uncertainty caused by large-scale renewable energy, electric vehicles (EV) and inverter air conditionings (IAC) connected to the commercial park microgrid (CPMG) bring new challenges to the flexible operation of the system. The paper presents a CPMG optimal scheduling method considering flexible resources on the demand side. Based on demand response models of EV and IAC, the flexible supply provided by CPMG flexible resources on the demand side is quantified. Combined with the inherent flexible resources and flexible demand of the source side, the index of flexibility shortage severity is proposed to quantitatively evaluate the imbalance severity between flexible supply and flexible demand of the system. On the basis, the CPMG multi-objective optimal scheduling model is established, which takes into account the operation economy and flexibility and solved by CPLEX optimization software. Simulation results show that the proposed model can coordinate various flexible resources on both sides of source and load, and effectively improve the operational flexibility of CPMG.

Author Keywords: flexible resource on the demand side

articleTitle: Assisted Decision Analysis for Active Distribution Grid Flexibility Resource Application
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: The proportion of renewable energy access to the distribution network is increasing, and the distribution network will be affected by the uncertainty of renewable energy output while consuming renewable energy. In order to ensure the system’s own power balance in real time and to ensure that the decision makers can reasonably allocate the flexibility resources to meet the system’s flexibility demand and cope with the uncertainty that may occur in the system. In this paper, a reasonable flexibility demand model is constructed to accurately predict the flexibility demand of the distribution network system; then the flexibility resources provided by gas turbines, energy storage devices and other controllable resources connected to the active distribution network is analyzed, so as to clarify the support capacity of the existing flexibility resources to the distribution network. Moreover, the shortage of the system flexibility resources is analyzed by adding a penalty term. Finally, the shortage of system flexibility resources is clarified by adding a penalty item, and an auxiliary reference is provided for the optimal allocation of distribution network side flexibility resources.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Medical Monitoring System Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: With the development of my country’s economy and the continuous improvement of national health awareness, the proportion of chronic diseases and sub-healthy people has increased year by year. The concept of wireless Internet of Things for monitoring individual physical parameters has been proposed. Through the combination of the medical system and the Internet of Things, the information on human physiological parameters can be remotely monitored. At the same time, continuous measurement of several important parameters such as human blood pressure, heart rate, blood oxygen saturation, and body temperature can reflect the patient’s physiological condition in real-time, which plays a crucial role in the prevention of diseases and emergencies.In this context, this paper designs an intelligent medical monitoring system, which is composed of self-designed and developed front-end monitoring hardware equipment and medical monitoring platform, which can realize the collection and transmission of wireless sign parameters, the detection results of physiological parameters, and the processing and display results on the intelligent terminal are given. The system can improve the efficiency of medical workers and improve the patient’s experience.

articleTitle: Active Distribution Network Grid Expansion planning Technology Based on Power Grid Carrying Capacity Improvement
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: The high proportion of grid-connected distributed energy with new energy as the main body has brought great pressure to the planning and operation of the distribution network. To measure and improve the bearing capacity of the active distribution network to uncertainty shock the carrying capacity index system of the active distribution network is proposed from the two aspects of power and operating state carrying capacity, and an active distribution network planning model considering the improvement of the carrying capacity of the power grid is constructed. The model is then solved using a fast non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm with an elite strategy. Finally, through the simulation analysis of the example based on the IEEE-33 node expansion test system, the scientificity and effectiveness of the established model are verified.

articleTitle: Distributed Robust Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy System Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Technology and Embedded Systems (ICITES)
abstract: With the rapid development of the energy internet, the coupling of different forms of energy is continuously strengthened. Integrated energy system (IES) provides a new way for wind power consumption. This paper introduces integrated demand response (IDR) into the demand side of IES, excavates the demand response potential of load side from two aspects of time shift and energy replacement, and smooths the load curve. At the same time, the two-stage distributed robust optimization model based on Wasserstein distance is used to deal with the uncertainty of wind power output. Aiming at minimizing system operation cost, the optimal unit scheduling strategy under the worst probability distribution of wind power output prediction error is found. Finally, the dual theory and affine strategy are used to transform the model into a mixed integer linear programming problem, which is easy to solve. Numerical examples are used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.
